acceptance.given: A proposed TC-D1 plan declares a Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking, or reinforcement-learning feature.

oracle.expected: The plan validator rejects the proposal as outside TC-D1 scope and no successful validation result accepts the excluded feature.
forbidden: Accepting autonomous Skill modification, ranking, or reinforcement-learning behavior.
Treating an excluded feature as TC-D1 scope.
oracle.observable: The validator returns failure with an exclusion-specific scope diagnostic for the proposed feature.

acceptance.then: Excluded autonomous and ranking features remain out of scope.
acceptance.when: When the Toolchain validator evaluates a proposed TC-D1 feature set.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the plan-validator unit test with each excluded feature proposal and require the validator to reject it as an out-of-scope semantic contract violation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Extend the TC-D1 Toolchain plan validator so proposed Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, learned-ranking, and reinforcement-learning features are rejected as excluded scope rather than accepted by plan validation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema changes; reverting the validator and its unit assertions restores the prior Toolchain-only validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposal containing an excluded TC-D1 feature transitions from candidate scope to rejected scope.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Plan validation fails for every proposal containing Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking, or reinforcement learning, while no excluded feature is accepted as TC-D1 scope.
